runtime_rules: Warp factor is an order/control value, not a universal distance formula.
The propulsion resolver supplies the effective velocity for the current ship, era/configuration and conditions.
Damage, available power, propulsion health and local subspace conditions can reduce sustainable speed.
Emergency warp may exceed normal sustainable limits only if the ship configuration and live state permit it.
Travel progress is persisted segment by segment so interruptions, encounters and rerouting are possible.
Core owns position and elapsed travel time. AI may describe them but cannot advance the ship.
